show: MESS with Sydnee Washington & Marie Faustin

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: Sydney Washington and Marie Foston announce the final episode of Mess.
kurzfassung: Sydney Washington and Marie Foston announce that this is the final episode of Mess on the iHeart network. They reflect on past episodes, chaotic vacations, and listener messages while joking about their unexpected cancellation. Despite the show ending, the hosts encourage fans to keep listening and sharing the podcast.
stichpunkte: Sydney and Marie announce that this is the final episode of Mess.
The hosts discuss the cancellation by iHeart and joke about their download numbers.
Marie shares a chaotic story about getting an air conditioner bought by a date.
Sydney talks about her flight getting canceled during a vacation in Mexico.
They read and react to a listener message about a friend whose dating life resembles an episode of Love Island.
The hosts read a second listener message about a friendship strained by strange colorism comments.
They joke about staging a dramatic breakup and trying to get Will Ferrell's attention for a new network.

kapitel.titel: The AC Saga and Vacation Chaos

clips.hook: Small money players, tiny paste soul players!
clips.text: The hosts joke that financial disagreements with their former network iHeart are the real reason their show is ending.

clips.hook: Breaking house laws while her mom was at Fordham Law!
clips.text: Marie recalls being caught being intimate at home while her mother was busy working at Fordham Law University.

clips.hook: Fifteen-day return policy on an air conditioner!
clips.text: Sydnee questions a strict two-week return window at a store right as she completes her purchase.

clips.hook: Block him when you want to talk, then block him again!
clips.text: The duo discusses the exhausting cycle of toxic texting habits and the realization that new partners often hide their flaws early on.

clips.hook: Your friend hit you with some black face makeup!
clips.text: The presenters react to a bizarre makeup experience where a beauty consultant handed a customer a foundation shade that was far too dark.
